title: Simplicity and usefulness
body:
There are so many things Iike in this app. 
The whole application is very good tool for fighting addictions and other bad habits, because you can easily get feedback from the app the moment you cheat, because the counter resets. And with the more time passes it gets even more motivating, because you don’t want to break the timer.
The idea with the counter, which can not be edited is adding pressure to perform good and it somehow feels like an encouragement for me to keep it.

Keep up the great work and good luck :)
